name: Python Programming Fundamentals
description: Core language syntax, data structures, functional patterns, object-oriented concepts, and robust error handling.

skills.name: Variables & Primitive Types
skills.description: Dynamic typing, integers, floats, strings, booleans, and variable assignment.

skills.name: Control Flow & Conditionals
skills.description: If/elif/else branching, ternary operators, and boolean logic.

skills.name: Loops & Iteration (for / while)
skills.description: For in range, while loops, break/continue statements, and enumerate.

skills.name: Functions, *args, **kwargs & Scopes
skills.description: Def, return, default parameters, variable-length arguments, and LEGB scope rule.

skills.name: Lists & Tuples
skills.description: Indexing, slicing, mutability vs immutability, and list methods (append, pop, sort).

skills.name: Dictionaries & Sets
skills.description: Key-value hash maps, set unions/intersections, O(1) lookups, and dict views.

skills.name: List & Dict Comprehensions
skills.description: Concise declarative collection transformation and filtering syntax.

skills.name: Exception Handling (try/except/finally)
skills.description: Raising custom exceptions, catching multiple error types, and cleanup blocks.

skills.name: File I/O & Pathlib
skills.description: Reading and writing text/binary files, Pathlib object paths, and CSV parsing.

skills.name: Modules, Packages & Virtual Environments
skills.description: Import system, __init__.py, requirements.txt, venv, and pip dependency management.

skills.name: OOP: Classes, Attributes & Methods
skills.description: __init__ constructor, instance attributes, self keyword, and encapsulation.

skills.name: Inheritance & Polymorphism
skills.description: Super() call, method overriding, abstract base classes, and multiple inheritance.

skills.name: Dunder Methods (__str__, __repr__, __len__)
skills.description: Operator overloading, string representations, and container protocol.

skills.name: Iterators, Generators & 'yield'
skills.description: Iterable protocol (__iter__, __next__), lazy sequence evaluation with yield.

skills.name: Decorators, Closures & First-Class Functions
skills.description: Function decorators, @wraps, parameterized decorators, and closure scopes.

skills.name: Type Hints & Static Type Checking
skills.description: Type annotations, Union, Optional, Generic, Callable, and mypy validation.

skills.name: Unit Testing with Pytest
skills.description: Test fixtures, assertions, parametrize decorators, and mocking.
